"""Convert legacy Meridian CRM account rows to the modern account shape."""

from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional


def _number(value: str) -> float:
    """Convert a legacy numeric string, treating blank values as zero."""
    return float(value) if value else 0.0


def _date(value: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """Convert YYYYMMDD to ISO YYYY-MM-DD, including legacy null sentinels."""
    if not value or value == "00000000":
        return None
    return datetime.strptime(value, "%Y%m%d").date().isoformat()


def convert_account(row: dict) -> Optional[dict]:
    """Convert one legacy ACCT_MASTER CSV row, excluding soft-deleted rows."""
    if row.get("DEL_FLG", "") == "Y":
        return None

    return {
        "account_id": row.get("ACCT_ID", ""),
        "name": row.get("ACCT_NM", ""),
        "account_type": row.get("ACCT_TYP", ""),
        "sic_code": row.get("SIC_CD", ""),
        "region": row.get("REGION_CD", ""),
        "annual_revenue": _number(row.get("ANN_REV", "")),
        "currency": row.get("CURR_CD", "") or "USD",
        "owner_id": row.get("OWNER_UID", ""),
        "team_code": row.get("TEAM_CD", ""),
        "credit_limit": _number(row.get("CRED_LIMIT", "")),
        "credit_hold": row.get("CRED_HOLD", "") == "Y",
        "created_date": _date(row.get("CREATE_DT", "")),
        "updated_date": _date(row.get("UPD_DT", "")),
    }
